abstract: A 54-year-old woman complained of abdominal pain and watery diarrhea that had begun two days before admission. Physical examination revealed abdominal distention and tenderness throughout the abdomen, but there was no muscle guarding or rebound tenderness. The leukocyte count was 27.0 x 10(3)/microl, and CRP was 28.5 mg/dl. A plain film of the abdomen revealed the shadow of a huge gas-containing mass with an air-fluid level and a dilated small intestine with air-fluid level. CT showed a huge gas-containing cystic mass with fatty component and solid structure. Omental thickening was also noted. Emergency surgery was performed, and an enlarged left ovary that was adherent to the small intestine was removed. Microscopic examination revealed a squamous cell carcinoma in the dermoid cyst wall. The carcinoma had directly invaded the small intestine and a fistula between the cyst and the intestine was noted. Thickened omentum showed granulomatous inflammation in the fatty tissue, but no metastases were detected. The histopathological diagnosis was dermoid cyst with malignant transformation and invasion of the small intestine. Chemotherapy was performed, but the patient died of progression of peritoneal metastases 10 months after the operation.
abstract_ja: 54歳の女性が、入院の2日前から始まった腹痛と水様性下痢を訴えた。身体診察では腹部全体に膨満と圧痛がみられたが、筋性防御や反跳痛はなかった。白血球数は27.0×10^3/μL、CRPは28.5 mg/dLであった。腹部単純X線写真では、air-fluid levelを伴う巨大なガス含有腫瘤の陰影と、air-fluid levelを伴う拡張した小腸が認められた。CTでは、脂肪成分と充実性構造を伴う巨大なガス含有嚢胞性腫瘤が示された。大網の肥厚も認められた。緊急手術が施行され、小腸に癒着した腫大した左卵巣が摘出された。顕微鏡検査で、類皮嚢腫の嚢壁に扁平上皮癌が認められた。癌は小腸に直接浸潤しており、嚢胞と腸管の間に瘻孔が認められた。肥厚した大網は脂肪組織に肉芽腫性炎症を示したが、転移は検出されなかった。病理組織学的診断は、悪性転化と小腸浸潤を伴う類皮嚢腫であった。化学療法が施行されたが、患者は術後10か月で腹膜転移の進行により死亡した。
